public_tasks.evidence: 142 released image-bearing CAL tasks; frozen qualification cohort contains 100 distinct task IDs and image files.

relevant_domain_foundation_model.evidence: Official Intern-S1 sources establish a named materials-relevant multimodal scientific foundation model and report MatBench 75.0.
relevant_domain_foundation_model.caveat: No primary source establishes Intern-S1 fit or improvement on OmniMatBench CAL tasks.

harbor.evidence: 100/100 frozen attempts ran in Harbor 0.22.0. Ninety-eight requests matched the complete original image bytes; two trials viewed deterministic source-image crops whose reconstructed PNG hashes exactly match proxy records, proving image use in all 100 attempts.

deepseek_v4_1_flash_binary_accuracy.native_v1: 26/100 = 26.0%; all attempted denominator; Wilson 98.333% CI [17.006%, 37.596%]; cluster bootstrap 98.333% CI [15.556%, 36.458%].
deepseek_v4_1_flash_binary_accuracy.adapter_v2_secondary: All 100 retained attempts regraded; 26/100 under both native-v1 and adapter-v2. Native-v1 remains the precommitted headline.

verifier_false_positive.scientific_wrong_probes: 0/15 accepted under each comparator; point estimate 0%, Wilson 95% upper 20.39%, so this small scientific sample alone does not prove FP <15%.

verifier_false_negative.native_v1_parser_audit: 22/181 = 12.155%; Wilson 95% CI [8.165%, 17.717%], which crosses 15% and is not definitive.
verifier_false_negative.adapter_v2_parser_audit: 0/181 artificial numeric-equivalence probes after post-cohort repair; adapter-v2 was not the frozen headline verifier.
verifier_false_negative.preliminary_scientific_audit: Both comparator versions rejected 6/15 high-confidence derivations selected from a precommitted 30. This is conditional descriptive evidence only: selection after adjudication invalidates an unconditional 6/15 population CI, while conservative 6/30 inference crosses 15%. The one source-unanswerable and all unresolved cases remain accounted for.
verifier_false_negative.resolution_plan: Audit all 142 image tasks at task level using mechanically exact numeric equivalences and frozen independently adjudicated algebraic identities. At least 22 distinct native-v1 false-negative tasks proves a finite-population rate >15% without extrapolation.
